sentences.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption sets out safeguards it considers necessary to reduce corruption risks in the planning system.
sentences.support: the Commission is communicating its view on the key anti-corruption safeguards that ought to underpin the NSW planning system

sentences.text: It examines decision-making criteria, competing public interests, transparency, complexity, community participation and third-party appeals.
sentences.support: the Commission puts forward what it believes are six key corruption prevention safeguards

sentences.text: The Commission cautions that frequent planning complaints do not themselves demonstrate corruption, while broad discretion over departures from plans creates risk.
sentences.support: This high ranking in complaint numbers, however, does not directly correlate with evidence of corruption.

sentences.text: Its 16 recommendations cover objective criteria, oversight, simpler rules, clearer decisions, public consultation and wider access to merit appeals.
sentences.support: The Commission has also made a number of recommendations that support the key safeguards.

findings.quote: This high ranking in complaint numbers, however, does not directly correlate with evidence of corruption.

notes: Recommendations were made in the context of developing new planning legislation. The introduction and overview includes the consolidated recommendations through PDF page 9.
